# Release Checklist

- [ ] Release version and tag are identified.
- [ ] Source, configuration, tests, and documentation are consistent.
- [ ] Frozen evidence hashes and provenance are unchanged.
- [ ] Manuscript and report artifacts are unchanged unless explicitly packaged.
- [ ] Citation, license, and community files are present.
- [ ] Reproducibility instructions use repository-supported commands.
- [ ] `compileall`, `pytest`, Markdown validation, and `git diff --check` pass.
- [ ] Generated artifacts have a manifest and checksums where applicable.
- [ ] Scientific scope and limitations are stated conservatively.
